title: Thumbs Up Season 5 TEASER (Philippines, Manila, Siargao)
summary: A sparse 47-second official-channel Season 5 teaser with seven caption records. It contains a spoken Manila greeting, an unresolved “Full blast, please,” an isolated “When?”, then a separate scene compared to a hospital where someone appears to eat crackers and porridge while connected to an IV. The speaker jokes that this is what they hope death will be like. Every word remains. Manila is spoken; Philippines and Siargao are title-level geography and cannot be assigned to every shot. “Like a hospital” does not prove a facility, and the IV supplies no diagnosis, patient identity or treatment. The death line is preserved as gallows humor in that scene, not evidence of suicidal intent or prognosis. Sparse cuts provide no publisher speaker labels; zero named turns ship.
